results.title: Soccer Season: Offside
results.overview: Soccer captain Mondli is doing his best. But with his father away and his mother not coping at home, it's not easy. When the demands at home and of his team clash, Mondli realizes what true leadership really is.

results.title: Jurassic Reborn
results.overview: When cutting-edge research leads to the creation of living dinosaurs, a team of scientists on a secluded island must risk their lives and confront the now-growing creatures to prevent the animals from escaping and attacking the mainland.

results.title: My Amish Double Life
results.overview: By day Emma is a good Amish girl, but by night she sneaks out with her Amish friend, Rebecca, and together they lead a double life, going to clubs, flirting with boys, and falling in love in the forbidden “English” world. When Emma accidentally witnesses a murder while out, her life and community is thrown into peril.

results.title: MYOPIA
results.overview: In this Greek Tragedy, A King named Myops is constantly plagued by horrific omens and decides to seek council from the Gods, only to soon discover that his past actions and hidden guilt, may have led him towards a gruesome fate once he forces the Oracle to enact a divination.

results.title: Cemetery
results.overview: A young couple of lovers is separated by the unexpected and tragic death of the girl. A few months after the incident, the man’s mental health has deteriorated. He starts to meet his dead lover in every corner.

results.title: Tras los pasos de Superpocho
results.overview: Documentary that follows a group of filmmakers who investigate the existence of a Peronist superhero that Perón allegedly proposed to publish. They interview historians, graphic artists, and sociologists to reconstruct this figure, whose evidence was destroyed after the 1955 coup d'état and the persecution of Peronism.

results.title: Elysian Fields
results.overview: Strong winds shake the leaves of drought-stricken trees in an ancient olive grove near Delphi, reminding us of the wildfires that are engulfing the country. Here, a family of farmers attempts to restore its land.

results.title: Someone to Run With- Gesher
results.overview: Assaf, a 16 year old boy, is trying to find the owner of a wandering lost dog in Jerusalem. The dog leads him through different places in Tamar's life story, a lonely and troubled girl on a dangerous mission to save her brother

results.title: Call Earl
results.overview: Eager to make new friends, Kate attends a slumber party, but the night takes a sinister turn when the girls play a strange party game.

results.title: Fast Edee
results.overview: Edee tries to corrects his old ways and start a new life with his daughter. Sadly his past catches up with him for one last job before he’s out.

results.title: Ghran
results.overview: A forgotten birthday makes a son realize how deeply he has overlooked his mother’s love, sending him on an emotional journey of memory and regret. Ghran is a touching family drama that beautifully celebrates the bond between a mother and child.

results.title: The D4 Alien
results.overview: Ronan, who hails from the people's republic of cork, is struggling to fit in in Dublin City (aka da big shmoke), as he lets his date, Eve, out of his apartment he starts to realize he can't keep up his facade any longer.

results.title: ripe
results.overview: Earthly and spiritual guides are a young Vietnamese woman’s allies as she decides whether to enter an arranged marriage in Solara Thanh Bình Đặng’s ethereal drama steeped in sensual rhythms of the land.

results.title: Everything About My Wife
results.overview: The film revolves around an unhappy married man who seeks the help of a Casanova to seduce his wife and get her to ask for a divorce.

results.title: Tigers Can Be Seen In The Rain
results.original_title: Ya se Ven Los tigres en la lluvia
results.overview: Drifting between moving-image formats and collaging local textures and bygone voices, Oscar Ruiz Navia’s film reflects on loss and mourning as experiences of temporal dislocation.

results.title: A Man I'm Attracted To
results.overview: Film critic Rita, in an attempt to meet “the one,” embarks on a journey through the labyrinth of her own memories, emotions, and feelings.
